dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent O and C-shaped structures with jagged, high-frequency serrated light perimeters transitioning to dark, low-intensity interior centers. Perimeter edges exhibit pixel-level irregularity rather than smooth curves.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the lower lateral boundary and the posterior region, appearing as localized light-gray spots without internal dark gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest annuli on the mid-dorsal flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with additional linear alignment of smaller structures following the longitudinal axis of the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Complex interconnected network of smaller light-intensity rings on the lower lateral flank forming a labyrinthine or lattice-like texture.
